result.rationale: The diff adds `if (response.statusText !== "OK") throw new HttpError(...)` in salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts. statusText is not guaranteed to be 'OK' (e.g., HTTP/2 responses and some proxies return an empty reason phrase, and any 2xx phrase differing from 'OK' would pass/fail incorrectly), so the check can misclassify successful responses as errors — or accept failures. Using response.ok / checking response.status is the correct approach. This is a verifiable defect introduced by this diff.

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the new refresh-token fetch checks `if (response.statusText !== "OK") throw ...` after calling `fetch("https://login.salesforce.com/services/oauth2/token", ...)`. `statusText` is not a reliable success indicator (may be empty or vary even for 2xx), so this can incorrectly throw on successful responses. The correct check would be `!response.ok` (or status range). This is a behavior-breaking defect introduced by the diff.
